(Japanese: '''六英雄を取り戻せ！''' ''Get The Six Heroes Back!'') is the 125th episode of ''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]'', and the 1,357th episode of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. It first aired in Japan on January 30, 2026<!-- and is scheduled to air in the United States on *day*-->.

==Plot==
[[HZ124|Having been separated]] to weaken their offensive power, the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] and [[Amethio]] call out their chosen Pokémon for the {{pkmn|battle}} against the [[Six Heroes]] empowered by the [[Strong Sphere|Super Strong Sphere]]s. However, things are not as smooth-sailing mostly due to the unfortunate [[type]] matchups. {{TP|Lucius|Kleavor}}'s {{type|Bug}} attacks are {{DL|Type|Type effectiveness|super effective}} against {{TP|Liko|Meowscarada}}; having gained the {{t|Ghost}} type since his [[Evolution]], {{TP|Roy|Skeledirge}} is now weak to {{rf|Galarian}} {{TP|Lucius|Moltres}}'s {{m|Fiery Wrath}}; {{p|Dragonite}} has to manage against {{TP|Lucius|Gouging Fire}}'s newly learned {{m|Ancient Power}} thanks to the Super Strong Sphere; {{TP|Dot|Quaxwell}} is [[Fainting|defeated]] by {{TP|Lucius|Arboliva}} while trying to give {{TP|Dot|Tinkaton}} an opening; and the [[White Zygarde]] is {{status|Freeze|frozen}} in place and loses some of its [[Zygarde Cell|Cell]]s by a supereffective {{m|Ice Beam}}.

In spite of their disadvantageous situations, everyone is able to adapt accordingly and turn the tide of their respective battles. [[Roy]] calms down and waits for an opening, getting {{TP|Roy|Kilowattrel}} to fly around to attract Moltres's attention while gathering electricity through {{a|Wind Power}}. [[Coral]] becomes impatient though, and orders Moltres to attack, resulting in Skeledirge helping out as Roy pulls out his [[Tera Orb]] and {{Tera}}stallizes Kilowattrel into a pure {{t|Electric}} type. A command for {{m|Spark}} from a high altitude from its {{pkmn|Trainer}} results in the {{pkmn|category|Frigatebird Pokémon}} learning {{m|Supercell Slam}} in the process, although it misses Moltres and hits the floor instead, inflicting [[crash damage]] on itself. Roy encourages Kilowattrel to try again and sings with Skeledirge, who uses {{m|Torch Song}} to give the Frigatebird Pokémon's Supercell Slam a boost in power that sends Moltres to the ground. In another area, [[Ult]] makes use of [[Lacey]]'s advice to check the [[Pokédex]], and while he couldn't find information on Gouging Fire, he did learn something about Dragonite. He then [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolves]] the Dragon Pokémon and has it use {{m|Twister}} to take hold of Gouging Fire's Ancient Power and send it back at the [[Paradox Pokémon]], landing two sets of supereffective attacks at once to end the battle. On [[Dot]]'s end, she calls out {{TP|Dot|Gholdengo}} to take Quaxwell's place and find an opening. [[Chalce]] attempts to get Arboliva to focus on Tinkaton, but Gholdengo is able to immobilize the Olive Pokémon with {{m|Make It Rain}} long enough for the Hammer Pokémon to defeat it with {{m|Gigaton Hammer}}. With Amethio, he has Zygarde use {{m|Thousand Arrows}}, though {{TP|Lucius|Lapras}} uses {{m|Mist}} to reduce visibility. This ends up being a ruse as Zygarde switches from its {{form|Zygarde|50% Forme}} to its 10% Forme to attack more efficiently, defeating Lapras with {{m|Core Enforcer}}. Elsewhere, thanks to {{TP|Liko|Hatterene}}'s {{m|Healing Wish}}, [[Liko]] Terastallizes her healed Meowscarada and commands her to move around, with Kleavor following her. [[Sidian]] realizes Liko's plan too late as Kleavor becomes entangled in Meowscarada's invisible stems, leaving it open to a Terastallization-enhanced {{m|Magical Leaf}} flurry.

As a result of the final attacks in each area, the walls glitch out and the group is no longer isolated, with Amethio spotting [[Spinel]] watching them. [[Pagogo]] {{a|Tera Shift|transforms}} into its {{form|Terapagos|Terastal Form}} to purify the Six Heroes, but Spinel demands for the Super Strong Spheres be used again. Although Coral and Sidian are reluctant, the [[Explorers]] use the items on the Six Heroes, completely destroying their bonds and causing them to attack each other indiscriminately. With Amethio’s agreement, Zygarde returns to its 50% Forme and collaborates with Pagogo to [[HZ087|create a barrier]] that displays the memories the Six Heroes have made, hoping to restore their bonds. Spinel scoffs at the attempt, but becomes stunned when the Six Heroes fight back long enough for Pagogo to purify the [[Laquium]] from them, transforming into its Stellar Form and Terastallizing the Six Heroes in the process. Spinel shifts his attitude, feigning innocence about his intentions, but Ult is not fooled and declares that the Rising Volt Tacklers will end things on [[Mount Pericarp]] before the group leaves the [[Explorers HQ]] with the Six Heroes in tow. Once they're gone, [[Indi]] and [[Rubina]] confirm the recordings are complete to a satisfied Spinel, who pulls up a screen, unaware of Chalce rolling her eyes upon realizing his intentions, and Coral and Sidian beginning to have doubts about the Strong Sphere.

Meanwhile, now free, the Six Heroes return to the {{pkmn2|wild}}, promising Zygarde and the Rising Volt Tacklers that they will meet again. Amethio also parts ways with the team, aiming to uncover more of Zygarde’s potential alongside [[Zirc]] and [[Onia]], but not before promising to reunite with them at [[Laqua]]. With the mission complete, the Rising Volt Tacklers decide to visit [[Naranja Academy]] to report their findings and stop the usage of the Strong Spheres. However, Spinel later releases altered footage of the battles to create further distrust against the Rising Volt Tacklers, framing them as criminals who took the Six Heroes from the care of the Explorers when they were found injured on Mount Pericarp, all while preparing for the eventual public release of the Strong Spheres.

==Major events==
<!-- This is not for summarizing everything that happens in this episode. Only events pertaining to the series as a whole, such as catching and releasing Pokémon and obtaining Badges, go here. -->
* [[Amethio]] is revealed to have {{pkmn2|caught}} the [[White Zygarde]].
* [[Roy's Kilowattrel]] {{Tera}}stallizes for the first time and learns {{m|Supercell Slam}}.
** In the process, Roy's Kilowattrel's Tera Type is revealed to be {{t|Electric}}.
* [[Ult]] meets [[Chalce]], [[Onia]], and [[Zirc]] for the first time.
* [[Lucius's Arboliva]], {{TP|Lucius|Moltres}}, {{TP|Lucius|Lapras}}, {{TP|Lucius|Kleavor}}, and {{TP|Lucius|Gouging Fire}}'s respective Tera Types are revealed to be {{t|Normal}}, {{t|Dark}}, {{t|Ice}}, {{t|Bug}}, and {{t|Rock}}.
* The [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] free the [[Six Heroes]] and let them return to their homes, with the promise to meet again at [[Laqua]] when the time comes. 
* Amethio, Onia, and Zirc leave to investigate the White Zygarde's remaining powers.
* The Rising Volt Tacklers decide to head to [[Naranja Academy]].
* [[Spinel]] frames the Rising Volt Tacklers again, further damaging their credibility and hindering their efforts to stop the launch of the [[Strong Sphere]]s.

==Trivia==
* [[Mega Nidothing's Mega Mega! Mega Evolution]]: {{p|Garchomp}}
* For the initial airing of this episode, the Mega Nidothing's Mega Mega! Mega Evolution segment was replaced by a special trailer for the upcoming episodes of the ''[[Rising Again]]'' arc. This trailer was later [https://youtu.be/d5_FWsZ8kQM uploaded] to the official Japanese [[YouTube]] channel.
* This episode does not contain any [[eyecatch]]es, instead having the [[series]] logo on the screen before and after the commercial break.
* As of this episode, [[Ult]] has met every high ranking member from the [[Explorers]].
* [[Roy's Kilowattrel]]'s {{m|Supercell Slam}} combined with {{TP|Roy|Skeledirge}}'s {{m|Torch Song}} is similar to  [[Ash's Swellow]] and {{AP|Pikachu}}'s Thunder Armor.
* Instead of the usual ending animation sequence, [[Asleep or Awake|the ending theme]] is played as an insert song near the end of the episode, with the credits being shown on-screen during the song.
** This is also the first episode to use an ending theme as an insert song since ''[[JN147|The Rainbow and the Pokémon Master!]]'' where [[Team Rocket's Team Song]] was used as such.
* Ult, [[Dot]], [[Liko]], and [[Roy]] narrate the preview for the [[HZ126|next episode]].

===Errors===
* Unlike other [[Shiny Pokémon]] kept in standard {{i|Poké Ball}}s, the [[White Zygarde]] is not shown sparkling as it exits it in this episode. This would only be seen for the first time in [[HZ134]].
